001: Carlos, how did the meeting go this morning?
It was quite productive, although it ran longer than expected.
I'm glad it went well. Did you make any important decisions?
Yes, in the end they approved the budget for the new project.
That's great, that's a big step for the team.
Indeed, now it's time to get down to work seriously.
002: Hey, Marta, have you seen the email the boss sent about the schedules?
Yes, I read it a while ago, but it wasn't very clear to me.
I think he's proposing to change the Friday afternoon shift.
Oh, was that it? Well, honestly, that would work better for me.
Me too, that way I can leave early for my weekend trip.
Great, so tomorrow we'll mention it to him to confirm.
003: Javier, can you give me a hand with this report?
Sure, tell me what you need and we'll see how to sort it out.
I just can't figure out how to organize this data.
Let me take a look for a moment, maybe it's easier with a table.
You're right, that makes it much clearer.
Glad I could help, that's what coworkers are for.
004: Have you eaten yet, Elena? I'm heading down to the cafeteria in five minutes.
Not yet, wait a moment and I'll join you.
Great, that way you can tell me how the course on Monday went.
It was very interesting, although some parts felt a bit tedious.
I can imagine, these courses tend to be very theoretical.
Yes, but at least they're good for meeting people from other departments.
005: Diego, sorry to bother you, do you have a moment for a quick question?
Yes, sure, go ahead. What's up?
I don't know how to fill out this part of the expense form.
Oh, that's easy. You just have to put the amount and the description.
Okay, so I'll fill it out and show it to you before sending it.
Perfect, that way I can confirm everything is correct.
006: Sofía, what do you think of the new project management system?
Honestly, I think it's more streamlined than the previous one.
I think so too, although there are still things I don't handle well.
Don't worry, it's just a matter of using it for a couple of weeks.
I hope you're right, because it stresses me out not mastering it.
Relax, if you need help, just tell me and I'll show you my tricks.
007: Good morning, Pablo. Do you mind if I open the window a bit?
No, quite the opposite, it's really stuffy in here.
It's just that I have a bit of a headache and I need some fresh air.
Go ahead, no problem, it'll do me good too.
Don't mention it, we have to look out for each other.
008: Laura, do you know if there's a department meeting tomorrow?
I think so, but I'm not sure about the exact time.
Okay, I'll ask the secretary to confirm it.
Good idea, that way we won't be caught off guard.
If you want, I'll let you know later on the team chat.
Perfect, I appreciate it. That way I can organize my morning better.
009: Carlos, did you have time to review the client's contract?
Yes, I looked it over quickly and it seems fine to me.
And did you see the clause about the delivery deadlines?
Yes, I read it carefully and it seems reasonable to me.
Then we can send it to the client so they can sign it.
Agreed, I'll prepare it and let you know before sending it.
010: Marta, how about we have lunch together on Thursday to celebrate?
That sounds like a great idea, it's been a while since we've had a nice chat.
We could go to that Italian restaurant you like so much.
I'd love that! That way we can also try that new dish they have.
Well, I'll book it this afternoon for the two of us.
Great, I can't wait for Thursday to get here.
